inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada is tightening immigration and asylum rules affecting Nigerians and others after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026. This is a troubling turn toward treating migration as a security problem rather than protecting people seeking safety. When governments harden borders, the costs fall hardest on migrants already facing unequal power and precarious circumstances.
